final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages), kept AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount, o.overall_average FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_kept_average FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.average_amount, k.average_amount - k.overall_average AS above_overall_average, k.average_amount - km.mean_kept_average AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS km ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
